_comment: Maps the species name as written on catch sheets -> canonical name in species_master.csv. Confirmed 2026-04-28. Beach-shorthand block (uppercase, as written on WCSAA scorecards) added 2026-06-25 — verified against species_master. Matching is CASE-SENSITIVE exact (scripts/scoring.py): the written string must match an alias key exactly. For species that exist in the master ONLY as (M)/(F) entries, the alias maps to the sexless BASE and the scorer reattaches gender from a trailing (M)/(F) — so those MUST be written with the fish sex, e.g. 'RAGGIE (F)'. The three below are sexless in the master and resolve without a sex suffix.
_sub_minimum_rule: Any catch entry containing '<' (e.g. '<0.5kg', '<1kg') in the species field scores zero — recorded for participation only.
